request.body: {"statements":["CREATE TABLE dbimp_t_types (id INT64 NOT NULL, i64 INT64, f64 FLOAT64, f32 FLOAT32, n NUMERIC, b BOOL, s STRING(MAX), y BYTES(MAX), d DATE, ts TIMESTAMP, j JSON, arr_i ARRAY<INT64>, arr_s ARRAY<STRING(MAX)>, arr_f ARRAY<FLOAT64>, arr_n ARRAY<NUMERIC>, arr_b ARRAY<BOOL>, arr_y ARRAY<BYTES(MAX)>, arr_d ARRAY<DATE>, arr_ts ARRAY<TIMESTAMP>, arr_j ARRAY<JSON>) PRIMARY KEY (id)","CREATE TABLE dbimp_t_dml (id INT64 NOT NULL, s STRING(MAX), n INT64) PRIMARY KEY (id)","CREATE TABLE dbimp_t_par (pid INT64 NOT NULL, name STRING(100)) PRIMARY KEY (pid)","CREATE TABLE dbimp_t_chi (pid INT64 NOT NULL, cid INT64 NOT NULL, v STRING(MAX)) PRIMARY KEY (pid, cid), INTERLEAVE IN PARENT dbimp_t_par ON DELETE CASCADE"]}
